2. Arithmetic consistency: capital R$ 402.000 = 150.000 + 252.000; distributable amount 33.482 = (420.000 − 18.216)/12; 18.216 = 1.518 × 12; pro-labore (officer compensation) 1.518; on-ramp 20% = 100.500 = 0.20 × 402.000; CTN test 96.000/1.296.000 = 7.41%; gap 50.000 − 33.482 = 16.518/month; 16.518 × 12 = 198.216/year; market value 60% = 540.000 − 252.000 = 288.000 profit (capital gain); 420.000 × 60% = 252.000; 900.000 × 60% = 540.000; Tema 796 upper-bound limit 402.000 ≥ 252.000.
3. numeros.json values should be consistent with the parecer (legal opinion).
4. Cross-references: § numbers cited in each file exist (e.g., §1.1, §1.3, §1.4, §2.2, §2.3, §3.2, §3.4, §4.1, §5.3, §7, §7.1, §9, checklist item E).

7. Line 55 of the checklist cites "Lei 15.270/2025, arts. 6º-A/6º-B" — verify whether the library actually says arts. 6º-A/6º-B and "15.270/2025". From the summary: lei15270 = "10% on the total payment exceeding R$50k/month, IRPFM ≥600k→1.2mi, pre-2026 profits are tax-exempt if approved by Dec 31, 2025 and paid by 2028". Whether "arts. 6º-A/6º-B" appears needs to be verified.

9. pro_labore file: confirm 11% + 20%, COSIT 120/2016, IN RFB 2.110/2022 art. 29, Lei 8.212 art. 12 V f, art. 21. Previously confirmed verbatim.

11. cf156: CTN art. 37's "2 years + 2 years" and new companies "following 3 years" — previously confirmed? The summary says "no CTN §§1º-4º, RE 1.495.108 pending (no UF)". The §8 source list in the parecer has "CTN art. 37 (preponderance of >50% of gross revenue, 2+2 years; new company: following 3 years)" — the checkpoint summary's "Relevant files" doesn't explicitly confirm the 2+2/3-year details, but under "Library facts verified verbatim" it says "cf156 = no CTN §§1º-4º, RE 1.495.108 pending (no UF)" — hmm, "no CTN §§1º-4º" probably means the library has CTN arts. 36/37 with §§1º-4º. Also "CTN arts. 36-37" cited at line 27 of the checklist — verify that art. 36 is in the file.
12. lei9249: capital contribution at book value → no capital gain. Previously confirmed.
13. 16. Confirm the assumption SM 2025 = 1.518 — this is presented as an assumption; no problem. But note: today's date is October 2026, and the SM 2026 should actually be known by that point — but the library has no SM data, and it's flagged as unknown; OK, already flagged.

22. The legal opinion §8 source-table entries need to be checked against the actual content of the files — previously verified verbatim.

25. The legal opinion header says the 1st round includes Q2/Q4/Q6 among the questions — consistent with §9? No problem.

Need to check whether §1.3 flags this as extrapolation or asserts it as library-backed. The library says: mandatory individual contributor (Lei 8.212, art. 12 V, f; art. 21) — a non-partner service provider is also an individual contributor under Lei 8.212 art. 12 V (may be stated in the library; "contribuinte individual obrigatório (Lei 8.212, art. 12 V, f; art. 21)" — if the library has that text, then asserting that she is an individual contributor is supported; however, the 11% retention rate at source applies to the individual contributing services to a PJ as a contributing individual — the library says 11% withheld + 20% employer share for pro-labore; whether 11% applies to non-partner service fees is not stated in the library). The contract's note 1 says as fact "11% de INSS retido na fonte como contribuinte individual" — needs a caveat, or at least a pointer to the unverified extension. Legal opinion §1.3 — need to read.
